description: Agent-Door conformance vector (ADR-026 / V1-11): the exact JSON shape of GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. `version` in the template is the literal string a consumer should treat as any SemVer; the reference implementation substitutes its crate version. Executed against the Rust implementation by koi-serve's agent_door_vector_matches_the_impl test.
rules: `mcp.path` is the absolute path of the Streamable HTTP endpoint.

`mcp.auth.scheme` is always "bearer" and `mcp.auth.header` names the DAT header; principals (ADR-026) instead present a client certificate on the mTLS management plane — the card does not change shape for them.
The card is unauthenticated and carries no secrets.
